standard.summary: 训练时随机丢弃图说中的部分 tag 的概率。默认 0（不丢弃）。
standard.effect: 设为 0.1 = 每个 tag 有 10% 的概率在本步训练中被丢弃。增加图说变化多样性，提升 LoRA 对不同 tag 组合的泛化。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集图说包含大量 tag（>10 个 tag/图）时，开启 dropout（0.05~0.1）可以提升生成的多样性和 tag 响应能力。
standard.avoidWhen: 图说非常短（如只有触发词）时，dropout 会让图说几乎为空，训练效果变差。

standard_en.summary: The probability of dropping individual tags from a caption during training. Default 0 (no dropping).
standard_en.effect: 0.1 = each tag has a 10% chance of being dropped on that step. It varies the captions more, so the LoRA generalises across tag combinations.
standard_en.whenToUse: When captions carry many tags (>10 per image), dropout of 0.05-0.1 improves both output variety and tag response.
standard_en.avoidWhen: With very short captions (just a trigger word), dropout leaves the caption nearly empty and training suffers.

advanced.principle: 对 caption 按 tag 分割后，对每个 tag 独立进行 Bernoulli 采样决定是否保留。触发词通常被保护，不参与 dropout。
advanced.tradeoffs: tag dropout 增加训练随机性，有助于防止模型过度依赖某些 tag 的组合，但会降低对 tag 语义的精确响应。

advanced_en.principle: Splits the caption into tags, then Bernoulli-samples each tag independently to keep or drop it. Trigger words are usually protected and excluded from dropout.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Tag dropout adds training randomness, helping prevent over-reliance on particular tag combinations, but reduces precise response to tag semantics.
